title: Dandy’s World Characters List: All 44 Toons, Abilities and Prices (1.0 Update, 2026)
summary: Every Dandy's World character after 1.0: all 44 Toons, new Lethal Toons Dessa and Dioda, abilities, prices, Twisteds and Christmas, Easter and Halloween Toons.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** As of the 1.0 update (November 20, 2026), *Dandy’s World* has **44 Toons** . **40 are playable** : 23 Regular Toons, 5 core Main Characters and 12 Holiday (Event) Toons, three of which are holiday Main Characters. The other **4 are Lethal Toons** (Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda) that only developers can play. New players start with **Boxten or Poppy** for free. Below is every character with their ability, price and Twisted, plus the two new 1.0 Toons.


Dandy’s World is a mascot horror survival game on Roblox by BlushCrunch Studio. You team up as cheerful Toons, finish Machines and head deeper into Gardenview Center while avoiding the Twisteds, the monstrous versions of every Toon. Since each Toon plays differently, knowing the full cast is the fastest way to pick a main, plan a team, or design your own Toon OC.

##


How Many Characters Are in Dandy’s World?


#


Group How many Who How you get them


Regular Toons 23 Blot, Boxten, Brightney, Brusha, Connie, Cosmo, Finn, Flutter, Gigi, Glisten, Goob, Looey, Poppy, Razzle & Dazzle, Rodger, Scraps, Shrimpo, Squirm, Teagan, Tisha, Toodles, Waxwell, Yatta Bought with Ichor in Dandy’s Store (most also need an unlock task)


Main Characters 5 core + 3 holiday Astro, Pebble, Shelly, Sprout, Vee, plus Bassie, Bobette and Gourdy Core Mains in Dandy’s Store; holiday Mains during their event


Holiday (Event) Toons 12 Christmas, Easter and Halloween casts (see below) Only during their event, with event currency


Lethal Toons 4 Dandy, Dyle, Dessa, Dioda Not playable (developer-only)


A few rules apply to the whole cast, according to the[fan-run Dandy’s World Wiki](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Toons) :


- Every Toon has **5 stats** (Skill Check, Movement Speed, Stamina, Stealth and Extraction Speed) shared across **15 stars** . Main Characters get **16 stars** .
- **Shrimpo** is the exception: he’s a challenge Toon with only 5 stars in total.
- Every known Toon has a matching **Twisted** .
- Your first Toon is free: pick **Boxten or Poppy** . The one you skip costs 100 Ichor later.


##


New in 1.0: Dessa and Dioda


#


The 1.0 update took Dandy’s World out of Alpha on November 20, 2026. The version note on the[official Roblox game page](https://www.roblox.com/games/16116270224/Dandys-World) lists the new mode, **The Labs** , with 11 floors, **“2 new OA Toons, Dessa & Dioda,”** a premium Rainbow-Time Bundle and thousands of lines of new lore and dialogue.


- **Dessa** (full name **Medessa Injectine** , OA-003) has a syringe for a head and wears a long white lab coat. In The Labs she’s the coordinator: she hands out Ambrosia and adjusts the run based on how your team performs. Her personality is pure mad scientist, and she was the assistant of Delilah Keen, the Gardenview co-founder who built the Toons’ bodies.
- **Dioda** (full name **Dioda Watts** , OA-002) has a box-shaped head with a power-box lid over one eye and colorful wires for arms and legs. She runs her own shop, idolizes Dessa, and is far friendlier: she wonders what a hug from Goob feels like and loves Boxten’s music.
- Both are **Lethal** Toons, so like Dandy and Dyle you can’t play them in normal runs.


*Note:* 1.0 details are only two days old. We’ll update this list as BlushCrunch Studio adds more Toons, including anything from the 2026 Christmas event.


##


Main Characters


#


Main Characters are the headline Toons of the cast. The five core Mains cost the most Ichor and unlock after 100% Research on their own Twisted, and every Main Character has **two abilities** (one active, one passive).

Shelly Shelly Fossilian **Inspiration** : +75% Extraction Speed for one teammate for 15s **Problem Solver** : speed boost when any Machine is done 4,250 Ichor


Sprout Sprout Seedly **Baked Sweets** : heals a teammate by 1 Heart for Tapes **Overprotective** : sees every alive Toon and their health 4,500 Ichor


Vee – **Mic Check** : highlights all Twisteds and Machines for 5s **Camera Hijack** : highlights the 2 nearest unfinished Machines 4,500 Ichor


Bassie (Easter) Bassie Bloomington **Springful Sharing** : drops items from her inventory for others **Easter Basket** : one extra item slot 3,000 Baskets + 2,500 Ichor


Bobette (Christmas) Bobette Carolynne **Precious Packaging** : hides in a gift box, invincible for 8s **Festive Aura** : faster Stamina regen and a speed boost for Toons near her 3,000 Ornaments + 2,500 Ichor


Gourdy (Halloween) Gourdy Holloway **Trick or Treat** : a random 20% boost for nearby Toons **Sugar Rush** : team speed boost when the Elevator opens and in Panic Mode 3,000 Pumpkins + 2,500 Ichor

##


Holiday (Event) Toons


#


Holiday Toons can only be bought during their event, in that event’s shop and with that event’s currency. If you missed one, you’ll have to wait for the event to come back.


###

##


Lethal Toons: Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda


#


Lethal Toons run the shops and the show. They have 5 stars in every stat and the same passive text (“The star of the show”), and only developers can play them in normal runs.


Toon Full name Number Role


Dandy Dandicus Dancifer L-001 The flower mascot. Runs Dandy’s Store (Toons, Trinkets, Gamepasses) and sells items between floors.


Dyle Dyle Timesly OA-001 A gold pocket watch who sells cosmetics like skins and stickers. Added in August 2025.


Dioda Dioda Watts OA-002 A cheerful, wire-limbed shopkeeper who idolizes Dessa. New in 1.0.


Dessa Medessa Injectine OA-003 The coordinator of The Labs, handing out Ambrosia. New in 1.0.


##


Twisteds: Every Toon’s Dark Side


#


Every Toon has a Twisted, a monstrous version that hunts you on the floors of Gardenview Center. Encountering Twisteds and collecting Capsules builds **Research** , and Research is how you unlock most Toons: Main Characters need 100% Research on their own Twisted, while Toons like Connie, Gigi, Glisten and Waxwell need 50%. Rodger’s passive doubles the Research you earn, which makes him a popular pick for unlocking the cast faster.


Waxwell with a Twisted close behind. © BlushCrunch Studio


Twisted designs are a big part of the fandom too. If you’re making a Toon OC, most fans design its Twisted form at the same time. Our[Dandy’s World OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/dandys-world-oc-maker) walks through it.


##


Which Toon Should You Pick? Characters by Role


#


Dandy’s World doesn’t have official classes, but the abilities above sort the cast into clear roles. Here’s a quick guide for new players:


- **Healers:** Sprout, Cosmo, Ginger, Teagan (self-heal) and Soulvester (blocks a hit).
- **Extraction (finish Machines faster):** Shelly, Brusha, Boxten, Squirm, Eggson and Cocoa.
- **Scouting:** Vee (Twisteds and Machines), Brightney (Blackouts), Coal and Pebble (items).
- **Speed and escape:** Tisha, Flyte, Finn, Flutter, Poppy, Looey, Connie and Rudie.
- **Support:** Astro (Stamina), Gourdy (random boosts), Waxwell (faster cooldowns), Bassie (shares items) and Blot (decoy).
- **Challenge pick:** Shrimpo, if you want to play on hard mode.


Starting out? Boxten is great on full teams, and Poppy’s speed burst helps you survive your first hits. Cheap early buys include Toodles (350 Ichor), Tisha and Finn (500 Ichor each).


##


Toon Numbers: The Lore Behind the Cast


#


In the lore, each Toon has a production number that roughly shows the order they were made: **L** for Lead, **OA** for Off-Air, **M** for Main and **SC** for Side Character. Lore hunters use these to piece together Gardenview’s history:


- **L-001:** Dandy
- **OA-001 to OA-003:** Dyle, Dioda, Dessa
- **M-001 to M-005:** Pebble, Astro, Sprout, Shelly, Vee
- **SC-001 to SC-005:** Cosmo, Shrimpo, Poppy, Boxten, Brightney
- **Other known SC numbers:** Glisten (SC-007), Razzle & Dazzle (SC-008A/B), Gigi (SC-011), Connie (SC-012), Goob (SC-014), Scraps (SC-015), Yatta (SC-019), Waxwell (SC-023)


Several numbers are still unknown, which is why fan theories (and fan-made Toons that “fill the gaps”) are so popular.

##


FAQ


#


###


How many characters are in Dandy’s World?


#


As of the 1.0 update on November 20, 2026, there are 44 Toons: 40 playable (23 Regular Toons, 5 core Main Characters and 12 Holiday Toons) and 4 Lethal Toons (Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda) that only developers can play.


###


Who are the new characters in Dandy’s World 1.0?


#


The 1.0 update added two Lethal Toons: Dessa (Medessa Injectine), the coordinator of the new Labs mode, and Dioda (Dioda Watts), a cheerful shopkeeper who idolizes Dessa. Neither is playable in normal runs.


###


Who are the Main Characters in Dandy’s World?


#


The five core Main Characters are Astro, Pebble, Shelly, Sprout and Vee. The holiday Main Characters are Bassie (Easter), Bobette (Christmas) and Gourdy (Halloween).


###


Can you play as Dandy?


#


Not in normal runs. Dandy, Dyle, Dessa and Dioda are Lethal Toons that only developers can play. Dandy runs Dandy’s Store and sells items between floors.


###


When can I get the Christmas Toons?


#


Bobette, Coal, Ginger and Rudie are only sold during the Christmas event, in Bobette’s Store for Ornaments. BlushCrunch Studio has confirmed the event returns in 2026 but hasn’t announced the date yet. Last year it ran from December 12, 2025 to January 16, 2026.
